# Read dataset and summarize data 
```{r}

## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Wolbachia_titers", "Metadata_strains.csv"), sep=",", header = TRUE))

##Read data of RP49 gene results
RP49 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data","raw_data", "Wolbachia_titers", "RP49.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE))

##Read data of ftsZ gene results
ftsZ <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data","raw_data", "Wolbachia_titers", "ftsZ.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE))

# Merge dataset to have Cp values for two replicates of RP49 gene for each sample
data1 <- data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(RP49 %>% dplyr::select(Pos, Cp), by = c("RP49_rep1" = "Pos")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cp_rep1 = Cp)
  
data1 <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(RP49 %>% dplyr::select(Pos, Cp), by = c("RP49_rep2" = "Pos")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cp_rep2 = Cp)

# Merge dataset to have Cp values for two replicates of ftsZ gene for each sample
data1 <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ftsZ %>% dplyr::select(Pos, Cp), by = c("ftsZ_rep1" = "Pos")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cp_rep3 = Cp)

  data1 <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ftsZ %>% dplyr::select(Pos, Cp), by = c("ftsZ_rep2" = "Pos")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cp_rep4 = Cp)
 
  #Change format for Cp values 
  data1 <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cp_rep1 = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Cp_rep1)))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cp_rep2 = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Cp_rep2)))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cp_rep3 = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Cp_rep3)))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cp_rep4 = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Cp_rep4))))
    
  ## Change names of Drosophila lines
### To do list of strains
strain_replacements <- list(
  "L6" = "Par6",
  "w140" = "Wat140",
  "w148" = "Wat148",
  "Sok28" = "Day28",
  "Sok58" = "Day58",
  "S24" = "Sap24",
  "T3" = "Tok3",
  "T10" = "Tok10",
  "T18" = "Tok18",
  "Trento IAEA" = "Trento"
)
      
for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  data1 <- data1 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Strain = stringr::str_replace_all(Strain, old_strain, new_strain))
}
  
## Export file with Cp values
write.table(x = data1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Cp_wolb.csv"), sep=",", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Count Wolbachia relative density
```{r}

# Load the data
data1 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Cp_wolb.csv"), sep=",", header = TRUE))

# Plot Cp
data_long <- data1 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Cp_rep"), 
               names_to = "Replicate", 
               values_to = "Cp")

ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Strain, y = Cp)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~Replicate, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +  # Creates four facets
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Strain", y = "Cp", title = "Cp for RP49 (two upper facets) and ftsZ (two lower facets)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

#Calculate mean Cp for two replicates
data1 <- data1 %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(RP49_mean = rowMeans(subset (data1, select = c(Cp_rep1,Cp_rep2)))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(ftsZ_mean = rowMeans(subset (data1, select = c(Cp_rep3,Cp_rep4))))

#Calculate relative density (Pfaffi et al, 2001, Hague et al, 2020)
data1 <- data1 %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Density = 2^(RP49_mean-ftsZ_mean))

#Add continent to the dataset
data1$Continent <- as.factor(ifelse(data1$Strain %in% c("Par6", "Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "Am^Bal","Am^Trento", "Am^Par6",  "Am^Rennes"), "Europe",
                         ifelse(data1$Strain %in% c("Wat140", "Wat148", "Day28", "Day58"), "America",
                                ifelse(data1$Strain %in% c("Tok10", "Tok3", "Sap24", "Korea", "China"), "Asia", NA))))

#Add CI phenotype
data1$CI <- as.factor(ifelse(data1$Strain %in% c("Trento", "Bal"), "CI",
                         ifelse(data1$Strain %in% c("Par6","Rennes", "Wat140", "Wat148", "Tok10", "Tok3", "Sap24","Korea", "Am^Bal","Am^Trento", "Am^Par6",  "Am^Rennes"), "no CI",
                                ifelse(data1$Strain %in% c("Day28", "Day58",  "China"), "Unclear", NA))))

#Filter NA (85rows left)
data1 <- data1 %>%
dplyr::filter(!is.na(data1$Density)) 

data1 <- data1 %>%
dplyr::filter(!is.na(data1$Continent))%>%
dplyr:: mutate(Strain = factor(Strain, levels = c("Trento", "Bal", "Par6", "Rennes","Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Par6",  "Am^Rennes", "Day28", "Day58", "Wat140", "Wat148", "China", "Korea", "Sap24", "Tok10", "Tok3")))


```
# Calculate mean titer and confidence intervals

```{r}
# Count mean titer for replicates
data_mean <-  data1 |>
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_titer = mean(Density),
    sd_titer   = sd(Density),
    n          = dplyr::n(),
    se         = sd_titer / sqrt(n),
    t_crit     = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low     = mean_titer - t_crit * se,
    ci_high    = mean_titer + t_crit * se
  )
  
 ## Export file with mean titer and confidence intervals values
write.table(x = data_mean, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Mean_titer.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE) 

#Alternative confidence interval estimation (I checked data, calculation is the same as in previous way)
install.packages("DescTools")
library(DescTools)

data_mean2 <-  data1 |>
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_titer = DescTools::MeanCI(Density, conf.level = 0.95)[["mean"]],
    ci_low     = DescTools::MeanCI(Density, conf.level = 0.95)[["lwr.ci"]],
    ci_high    = DescTools::MeanCI(Density, conf.level = 0.95)[["upr.ci"]],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

# Plot for introgressed strains and nanural strains

```{r}
#Filter only lines from Europe
data3 <-data1|>
  dplyr::filter(Continent == "Europe") #40 rows

data3 <- data3 |>
  dplyr::mutate(LineType = dplyr::case_when(
    Strain %in% c("Trento", "Bal", "Par6", "Rennes") ~ "Natural line",
    Strain %in% c("Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Par6","Am^Rennes") ~ "Introgressed line",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))



#Merge with mean titer
strain_replacements <- list(
  "Trento IAEA" = "Trento")
  
for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  data_mean <- data_mean %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Strain = stringr::str_replace_all(Strain, old_strain, new_strain))
}

data3 <- data3 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(data_mean %>% dplyr::select(Strain, mean_titer, ci_low, ci_high), by = "Strain")

#Change order of lines
data3 <- data3 |>
dplyr:: mutate(Strain = factor(Strain, levels = c("Trento", "Am^Trento", "Bal", "Am^Bal", "Par6", "Am^Par6", "Rennes",    "Am^Rennes", "Day28", "Day58", "Wat140", "Wat148", "China", "Korea", "Sap24", "Tok10", "Tok3")))

#Change names for introgressed lines
x_label_names <- c("Am^Bal" = bquote(~Am^Bal), "Am^Trento" = bquote(~Am^Trento), "Am^Rennes" = bquote(~Am^Rennes), "Am^Par6" = bquote(~Am^Par6))


#Plot for natural and introgressed lines in two small facets

plot1 <- ggplot(
  data3,
  aes(x = Strain, y = Density, fill = CI)
) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = x_label_names) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("CI" = "sienna1", "no CI" = "yellow", "Unclear" = "gray")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ LineType, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Drosophila line",
    y = expression(italic("Wolbachia") ~ " titer"),
    fill = "CI status"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
plot1
```

# Correlation between hatch rate in test cross and Wolbachia density

```{r}

# Load the data with hatch rate
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

# Filter and keep data only for screen for CI (1031 rows)
merged_data <- merged_data  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = as.factor(CrossTypeLabel))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID =as.factor(CoupleID))

#Load hatch rate data from zero-inflated model
data2 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Batch.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

data2 <- data2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

#Change names of strains
### To do list of strains
strain_replacements <- list(
  "L6" = "Par6",
  "L7" = "Par7",
  "MT47" = "Mon47",
  "W140" = "Wat140",
  "W120" = "Wat120",
  "W148" = "Wat148",
  "Sok28" = "Day28",
  "Sok58" = "Day58",
  "Sok80" = "Day80",
  "S24" = "Sap24",
  "S11" = "Sap11",
  "T3" = "Tok3",
  "T10" = "Tok10",
  "T18" = "Tok18"
)

change_name <- function (data2, strain_name_old, strain_name_new) {
  data2 <- data2 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CrossType = stringr::str_replace_all(CrossType, strain_name_old, strain_name_new)
    )
}
for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  data2 <- change_name(data2, old_strain, new_strain)
}
data2 <- data2 |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Merge datasets
median_hatch_rate <- dplyr::left_join(x=data2, y=merged_data[, c("CoupleID", "CrossType", "CrossTypeLabel", "hatchrate","Female", "Male", "Continent", "Area", "Cross", "Batch", "Block", "Year")], by = "CrossType")

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::filter (Continent=="Europe") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm","BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes",  "Par6xPar6", "AmxPar6", "Par6xAm"))

### Remove the same CrossTypes (13 rows left)
median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)


data_hatch <- median_hatch_rate_reduced %>%
  dplyr::filter(median_hatch_rate_reduced$Cross == "Test cross W- x W+")

# Count mean density for replicates
#data_density <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean (Density))

#Add information about type of strain to the dataset
data_density <- data_mean %>%
  dplyr::left_join(data1 %>% dplyr::select(Strain, CI), by = "Strain")

### Remove the same rows (13 rows left)
data_density <- data_density %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Strain, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
# Merge mean density and median hatch rate

strain_replacements <- list(
  "Trento IAEA" = "Trento")
  
for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  data_density <- data_density %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Strain = stringr::str_replace_all(Strain, old_strain, new_strain))
}

data_density <- data_density %>%
  dplyr::left_join(data_hatch %>% dplyr::select(Male, Estimate, X2.5., X97.5., Continent, CrossType), by = c("Strain" = "Male"))%>%
  dplyr::rename(Density = `mean_titer`)

data_density <- data_density %>%
  dplyr::filter (Continent=="Europe") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm","BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes",  "Par6xPar6", "AmxPar6", "Par6xAm"))

#Plot a correlation

ggplot(data_density, aes(x = Density, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = CI), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +  # Points colored by CI status
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = ci_low,
      xmax = ci_high,
      color = CI
    ),
    height = 0.02,   # thickness of horizontal bars
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  # Vertical error bars for hatch rate (y)
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = X2.5.,
      ymax = X97.5.,
      color = CI
    ),
    width = 0.02,    # width of the "cap" on vertical bars
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Strain, color = CI),
    size = 5,
    nudge_y = 0.05,      # move labels up slightly (adjust as needed)
    show.legend = FALSE,  # keeps legend clean
  segment.color = NA 
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +  # Regression line
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x = 0.1, label.y = 0.9) +  # Spearman correlation coefficient
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CI" = "sienna1", "no CI" = "yellow3", "Unclear" = "gray")) +  # Custom colors
  labs(
    x = expression(italic("Wolbachia")~" titer"),
    y = "Hatch rate in test cross (CI strength)",
    title = expression("Correlation between " * italic("Wolbachia") * " titer and CI strength"),
    color = "CI status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
#Save mean Wolbachia titer estimation
write.table(x = data_density, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Wolb_mean_titer.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```
